name: Post
definition: A content record in the posts table. Every row is one post; the PostTypeId value determines whether it is a question, an answer, or one of the auxiliary post types (tag wiki, tag excerpt, moderator nomination and similar).
scope: All analysis over the posts table; the parent entity of questions, answers, comments, votes and revisions.

name: Question
definition: A post with PostTypeId = 1. It is the only post type that carries Title, Tags, ViewCount, AnswerCount and FavoriteCount, has no ParentId, and is the only post type that can carry AcceptedAnswerId or ClosedDate.
scope: Question-level analysis: topical coverage, acceptance, closure, viewership.

name: Answer
definition: A post with PostTypeId = 2. It has no Title and no Tags, and it points at the question it replies to through ParentId.
scope: Answer-level analysis: answer volume, answer score, accepted-answer identification.

name: Accepted Answer
definition: The answer designated as accepted for a question. It is recorded on the question row in posts.AcceptedAnswerId, whose value is the Id of one of that question's answers. It can additionally appear as a vote row with VoteTypeId = 1, but that second representation covers only a small subset.
scope: Acceptance-rate, best-answer and question-resolution analysis.

name: Tag
definition: A topical label. Each tag has one row in the tags table, and the same tag name is also embedded in the denormalized posts.Tags text of every question that carries it.
scope: Topical grouping and comparison of questions.

name: User
definition: A registered account in the users table, identified by Id. Users own posts, author comments and votes, and receive badge awards.
scope: Author, reputation and contribution analysis.

name: Comment
definition: A comment record in the comments table. Each comment is attached to exactly one post through PostId and may itself carry a score and an author.
scope: Discussion-volume and clarification analysis around posts.

name: Vote
definition: A single vote event recorded in the votes table, characterised by VoteTypeId and optionally carrying a BountyAmount. Vote rows are the only per-event record of voting behaviour in this database.
scope: Voting-behaviour and bounty analysis; note the table is only a partial snapshot of the site's voting history.

name: Badge Award
definition: One row in the badges table: the award of a named badge to one user at one point in time.
scope: User recognition and achievement analysis.

name: Post Link
definition: A directed link record in the postLinks table connecting a source post (PostId) to a related post (RelatedPostId), classified by LinkTypeId.
scope: Relationship analysis between posts, including duplication.

name: Post Revision
definition: One row in the postHistory table: a recorded change to a post (creation of a field, edit, rollback, closure, lock, or similar), carrying the affected post, a type, a timestamp and a text payload for some types.
scope: Edit-history, revision-count and moderation-timeline analysis.

name: Bounty
definition: A reputation bounty placed on a post, represented as vote rows that carry a non-null BountyAmount. It forms a start/close pair within the votes table.
scope: Bounty-offering analysis; only available inside the narrow votes snapshot.

name: Reputation
definition: The lifetime reputation score stored on a user row, ranging from 1 to 87393 in this database. It is a maintained aggregate, not a quantity that can be recomputed from the votes table.
scope: User ranking and expertise-proxy analysis.

name: Post Score
definition: The net score denormalized on a post row. It is a maintained value covering the full site history and is not reproducible from the votes table.
scope: Popularity and quality ranking of questions and answers.

name: View Count
definition: The number of times a question has been viewed, stored only on question rows. It is null for every answer and for the auxiliary post types.
scope: Reach and attention analysis of questions.

name: Answer Count
definition: The number of answers a question has, denormalized on the question row. It was verified to agree exactly with the number of PostTypeId = 2 posts whose ParentId equals the question Id, for all questions in the database.
scope: Answer-volume analysis per question; not defined for answers.

name: Tag Usage Count
definition: The number of questions a tag labels, precomputed on the tag row. It approximates, but does not exactly equal, a recount over the denormalized posts.Tags text.
scope: Tag popularity ranking.

name: Comment Score
definition: The score stored on a comment row.
scope: Comment-quality analysis.

name: Post Type
definition: The posts.PostTypeId discriminator that separates questions (1), answers (2) and the auxiliary post types (3, 4, 5, 6, 7). The value governs which columns of posts are populated.
scope: Any analysis that must separate questions from answers or exclude wiki/nomination posts.

name: Vote Type
definition: The votes.VoteTypeId discriminator that distinguishes accepted, up, down, favourite, moderator-review, approval and bounty vote events.
scope: Vote-behaviour breakdowns.

name: Post History Type
definition: The postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId discriminator classifying each recorded change to a post; 25 distinct values are present, the largest being the body- and tags-related creation and edit types.
scope: Revision and moderation timeline analysis.

name: Post Link Type
definition: The postLinks.LinkTypeId discriminator; value 1 marks a general link between two posts and value 3 marks a duplicate relationship whose source post is almost always closed.
scope: Post-to-post relationship and duplication analysis.

name: Post Creation Time
definition: The timestamp at which a post was created. It is exposed under the column name CreaionDate on posts; the spelling omits the 't' and differs from the CreationDate column used by the other tables.
scope: Time-bucketing and trend analysis of posts.

name: Post Last Activity Time
definition: The timestamp of the last activity on a post, exposed under the column name LasActivityDate on posts.
scope: Recency and staleness analysis of posts.

name: Question Closure Time
definition: The timestamp at which a post was closed, stored in posts.ClosedDate. It is populated for closed questions only.
scope: Moderation and question-lifecycle analysis.

name: Community Owned Time
definition: The timestamp at which a post became community-owned (wiki-style collective ownership), stored in posts.CommunityOwnedDate. It is independent of ownership by the system 'Community' account.
scope: Collective-ownership analysis.
